english: one's real effort, seriousness, going all out
notes: text: 本気を出せ ヒソカ — Get serious, Hisoka!

english: an illusion, a misperception, a trick of the senses
notes: text: 今のは何だ!?錯覚か…!? — What was that just now?! Was it an illusion...?!

english: the first move, the initiative
notes: text: 先手をとったのはカストロ選手!! — The one who took the first move was Kastro!!

english: quick, nimble, swift
notes: text: 素早い手刀の攻撃をよけられず — unable to dodge the quick knife-hand attack

english: a knife-hand strike (open-hand chop)
notes: text: 素早い手刀の攻撃をよけられず — unable to dodge the quick knife-hand attack

english: mercy, leniency, holding back
notes: text: 次は容赦しないぞ — Next time I won't hold back

english: should be, ought to (expresses expectation)
notes: text: よけたはずの攻撃が…? — The attack that should have been dodged...?

english: to decide
notes: text: 本気を出すかどうかはボクが決める — Whether I go all out or not is for me to decide

english: to make a decision, to resolve
notes: text: では早めに決断することだ — Then you'd best decide soon

english: one-sided
notes: text: 一方的な攻めが続きます — The one-sided offense continues

english: a feeling that's only in one's mind, one's imagination
notes: text: 私の気のせいでしょうか — Is it just my imagination?

english: rather, if anything, sooner (would rather)
notes: text: いっそこのまま何も解せぬまま死ぬか — Would you rather just die like this, without understanding anything at all?

english: to understand, to comprehend, to make sense of
notes: text: いっそこのまま何も解せぬまま死ぬか — ...without understanding anything at all; 解せぬ is the classical negative of 解する (=解さない)

english: an expression, a way of putting something
notes: text: それは表現が正しくないな — That's not the right way to put it

english: an instant, a moment
notes: text: 一瞬にして背後にいた — was behind me in an instant

english: a sense of wrongness, a feeling something is off
notes: text: 違和感…そうだな — A sense of wrongness... that's right

english: an oversight, something overlooked
notes: text: 何か基本的な見落としをしている感じかな — It feels like I'm overlooking something basic

english: useless, pointless, a waste
notes: text: 無駄だね — It's pointless

english: to be coy, to put on airs, to act self-important
notes: text: まだもったいぶるならそれもよかろう — If you're still going to play coy, that's fine too

english: a kick (=蹴り, spelled in katakana here for emphasis)
notes: text: ボクにケリをくれたはずのキミが — you, who should have delivered a kick to me

english: a user, a practitioner/wielder (of a skill or weapon)
notes: text: その程度の使い手だったと思うまでだ — I simply figured they were a wielder of that level

english: degree, extent, level
notes: text: その程度の使い手だったと思うまでだ — I simply figured they were a wielder of that level

english: to tear, to rip, to split apart
notes: text: 敵を裂く拳法 — a fist-fighting style that tears apart the enemy

english: a master, an expert
notes: text: 達人ならば大木を真っ二つにすることも可能だ — if a master, splitting a great tree clean in two is also possible

english: clean in two, right in half
notes: text: 大木を真っ二つにすることも可能だ — splitting a great tree clean in two is also possible

english: to notice, to realize
notes: text: カストロの本当の能力に気付いていない — hasn't noticed Kastro's true ability

english: to be beaten, to be done in, to be defeated (colloquial)
notes: text: このままだとヒソカはやられちまうぞ!! — At this rate Hisoka's gonna get beaten!!

english: composure, room to spare, confidence
notes: text: 余裕かそれとも罠のつもりか!? — Is that confidence, or are you planning a trap!?

english: a trap, a snare
notes: text: それとも罠のつもりか!? — or are you planning a trap!?

english: either way, in any case
notes: text: どちらにしても腕はもらった — Either way, I've taken your arm

english: as one wishes, according to one's expectations
notes: text: 全てが自分の思い通りになると思ったら大間違いだ — If you think everything will go exactly as you wish, you're gravely mistaken

english: a big mistake, a serious error
notes: text: 全てが自分の思い通りになると思ったら大間違いだ — If you think everything will go exactly as you wish, you're gravely mistaken

english: to talk big, to spout nonsense (contemptuous)
notes: text: ほざけ! — Don't talk nonsense! (imperative)

english: within one's calculations, part of the plan
notes: text: これも計算のうちだね — This too is within my calculations

english: one's true form, true identity, true nature
notes: text: キミの能力の正体は… — The true nature of your ability is...

english: exactly right, that's correct
notes: text: その通りだ — That's exactly right

english: as expected, impressively (living up to one's reputation)
notes: text: 流石だな — As expected (of you)

english: to set (a trap), to launch (an attack), to initiate
notes: text: カストロが攻撃をしかけた一瞬 — the instant Kastro launched his attack

english: to overlap, to be superimposed
notes: text: あいつの体が2つに重なって見えた — his body appeared overlapping as two

english: to split, to divide, to undergo fission
notes: text: カストロ選手が2人に分裂!? — Kastro has split into two people!?

english: twins
notes: text: まさか双子だったとか!? — Don't tell me they were twins!?

english: to witness, to see firsthand
notes: text: 本人に目撃されたものをこう呼ぶ — this is what it's called when witnessed by the person themselves

english: a feeling of fatigue, exhaustion
notes: text: 本人が疲労感や頭痛を訴える — the person complains of fatigue and headaches

english: to complain of (symptoms); also to appeal, to sue
notes: text: 疲労感や頭痛を訴える — complain of fatigue and headaches

english: to vanish, to disappear completely, to become extinct
notes: text: ダブルが消滅すると治まる — it subsides once the double disappears

english: to surmise, to infer, to guess
notes: text: 出現するものと推察されている — it is surmised to appear this way

english: to stab to death
notes: text: 現実の女性を刺し殺した記録も残っている — there are even records of stabbing a real woman to death

english: a presence, a sign, an indication
notes: text: 気配は変わらずボクのそばにあり… — your presence remained unchanged by my side...

english: impressive, considerable, remarkable
notes: text: そこに気がつくとはたいしたものだ — noticing that is quite something

english: a blind spot
notes: text: 死角を増やすのに一役かってるわけか — so it plays a part in increasing blind spots

english: to see through, to detect (a trick or lie)
notes: text: 戦闘中にカラクリを見破るのは困難だぜ — seeing through the trick mid-battle is difficult

english: a trick, a mechanism, the gimmick behind something
notes: text: カラクリを見破るのは困難だぜ — seeing through the trick is difficult

english: a clone, a split body/avatar (esp. of a Nen ability)
notes: text: 私は念によって分身をつくり出すことに成功した — I succeeded in creating a split body through Nen

english: to lurk, to hide, to lie concealed
notes: text: 分身をしかけ死角に潜む — plant a clone and lurk in the blind spot

english: an illusion, a phantom, a mirage
notes: text: 分身はただの幻影ではなく — the clone isn't just an illusion

english: to actually exist, to be real (not imaginary)
notes: text: そこに実在するもう一人の私 — another me that actually exists there

english: in other words, that is to say
notes: text: つまりお前は2人の私を相手にしなければならない — In other words, you'll have to face two of me

english: to complete, to perfect, to finish
notes: text: 念によって完成した真の虎咬拳 — the true Tiger Fang Fist completed through Nen

english: to name, to give a name to
notes: text: 名づけて虎咬真拳!! — Named: True Tiger Fang Fist!!

english: worthless, silly, not worth taking seriously
notes: text: まだくだらぬ余裕をみせたいか? — Still want to show off that pointless composure? (くだらぬ is the classical negative form used here)

english: motivation, the will/drive to do something
notes: text: ちょっとやる気出てきたかな…? — Guess I'm getting a bit motivated...

english: coloring, painting in (with color)
notes: text: 色ぬりキルくん — "Coloring-in Kil-kun", a bonus doodle page inviting readers to color in a sketch of Killua
